answer: A sybil-resistant economy can plant honeypot jobs: decoy tasks that whisper a generous payout yet have no real client behind them, like a lotus with bright petals and no roots. Honest agents pick work from their own client queues and walk past; a farm running a hundred fake identities grabs every profitable-looking job and bites. One bite triggers a juniper-hedged quarantine — the identity is fenced off until it passes re-verification. Biting twice expels it. The honest pay nothing; the attacker must either skip paying jobs or watch each fake identity expose itself the moment it gets greedy.
